entities.name: 3GPP PS data off
entities.description: A feature allowing UE to restrict uplink data transmission except for exempt services. UE can be configured with exempt service lists for HPLMN/EHPLMN and VPLMN.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element used to carry 3GPP PS data off UE status during various procedures.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in PCO IE.

entities.name: UE-requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in PCO IE.

entities.name: UE-requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to indicate change of 3GPP PS data off UE status for PDN connection.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message
entities.description: Message used by network to indicate support of 3GPP PS data off during default bearer activation.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status
entities.description: UE status indicating whether 3GPP PS data off is activated or deactivated.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services for HPLMN/EHPLMN
entities.description: List of services exempt from 3GPP PS data off restrictions when UE is in HPLMN or EHPLMN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off exempt services for VPLMN
entities.description: List of services exempt from 3GPP PS data off restrictions when UE is in VPLMN.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status is activated
entities.description: Condition where UE restricts uplink data transmission to exempt services only.

relations.description: UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in PCO IE during attach procedure
UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in PCO IE during PDN connectivity procedure
UE provides 3GPP PS data off UE status in PCO IE during bearer resource modification procedure
Network indicates 3GPP PS data off support in PCO IE during default bearer activation
When PS data off is activated, UE allows uplink packets only for exempt services in HPLMN/EHPLMN
When PS data off is activated, UE allows uplink packets only for exempt services in VPLMN
Change in 3GPP PS data off UE status triggers UE-requested bearer resource modification procedure
